Swell windows HELD at their stored arcs and optimal_swell_dir: the ray-cast does not write these spots. Applied by pipeline/sw1_raycast.py (_apply_raycast_result, mode=full) and by pipeline/enrich.py (Algo 2a, after the ray-cast or the carried-forward arcs), so neither a full ray-cast nor a re-enrich moves them. Two kinds of entry. The twenty-one SE Florida entries are the windows those spots carried on main when they were held (main 7839cc0), copied verbatim, not authored. The four added on 2026-11-17 (kanaha-beach, ho-okipa, lovers-point, monterey-beach) are HAND-SET from cited surf guides, each with its sources in its own `source` field: the straight-ray cast cannot see swell that wraps around a headland or coast (sw1-raycast run 80), and a full run must not overwrite what the guides say.

WHY THE TWENTY-ONE SE FLORIDA SPOTS. Ten were held on 2026-10-19, Hillsboro Beach to Hobe Beach. The R1-R3 island rules (pipeline/enrichment/swell_window.py) judge each island on its own run of rays, so the Bimini group (1-23 km2 at 90-114 km) no longer borrows Cuba's run 600-700 km behind it, and on the land data alone every one of these spots would open its south-east gap (run 18: Hillsboro Beach [17-127, 145-175] -> [17-175]). The land data is not the whole obstacle here: the Great Bahama Bank is a shallow platform a few metres deep that breaks and refracts swell long before it reaches the islands GSHHG draws, so it shelters south-east Florida more than its islands do. Until that sheltering is measured (NWPS or the answer key), these spots keep the windows they had. Eleven more were held on 2026-10-20 after full run 24 showed the same south-east gaps reshuffling around the Bahamas on either side of the first ten: South Beach Miami, Haulover Inlet, Sunny Isles, Spoils, Fort Lauderdale Beach, Commercial Pier, Boca Raton Inlet, Palmetto Pavilion, Palm Beach, Ocean Reef Park and Bathtub Beach. Spoils also carries a hand-set optimal_swell_dir in spot_swell_windows.json (40); its held optimal is that same value.

TO RELEASE A SPOT, delete its entry; the next full ray-cast writes its R1-R3 window. Keys are slugs as pipeline/db_import._slugify makes them; `name` is for the reader and is checked against the roster by pipeline/tests/test_swell_window_holds.py.
note: SE Florida, South Beach Miami to Bathtub Beach: the Great Bahama Bank's shallow water shelters more than the land data shows. Kanaha Beach, Hoʻokipa, Lovers Point and Monterey Beach: hand-set windows from cited guides (2026-11-17).

kanaha-beach.name: Kanaha Beach
kanaha-beach.source: Hand-set 2026-11-17 from cited guides: surfnerd.com/surf-forecast/kanaha "Workable swell: NW - NE. Best from N", exposure "NW - ENE"; en.wannasurf.com Kanaha "Good swell direction: North, NorthWest, East, NorthEast"; surf-forecast.com/breaks/Kanaha "the best swell direction is from the north northeast". Window NW to E (315-90, no pad) takes in the trade swell that wraps around the Spreckelsville-Paia coast; the straight-ray cast stops at 47 (63 even from 600 m offshore: sw1-raycast run 80). Optimal kept at 4, inside the cited N-NNE.

ho-okipa.name: Hoʻokipa
ho-okipa.source: Hand-set 2026-11-17 from cited guides: surfnerd.com/surf-forecast/hookipa "Workable swell: NW - E. Best from NW"; tombarefoot.com Hookipa guide "Best Swell Directions? North, Northwest, Northeast" and "catch the surf from the tradewinds swells"; en.wannasurf.com Hookipa "Good swell direction: North"; surf-forecast.com/breaks/Hookipa "the best swell direction is from the north northeast". Window NW to E (315-90, no pad) takes in the trade swell; the straight-ray cast stops at 43 (63 even from 600 m offshore: sw1-raycast run 80). Optimal N (0), the middle of the cited NW / N / NNE.

lovers-point.name: Lovers Point
lovers-point.source: Hand-set 2026-11-17 from cited guides: surfnerd.com/surf-forecast/lovers-point "Workable swell: W - N. Best from NW"; surf-forecast.com/breaks/Lovers-Point "the best swell direction is from the northwest". Window W to N (270-0, no pad): swell wraps around Point Pinos, which the straight-ray cast cannot see (it opens 317-319 only: sw1-raycast run 80). Optimal 315 as in spot_swell_windows.json (four guides, NW).

monterey-beach.name: Monterey Beach
monterey-beach.source: Hand-set 2026-11-17 from guides to Del Monte Beach, about 1 km east of this spot (36.6052, -121.8704 per surfnerd; this spot 36.6033, -121.8814), the nearest sourced break, used as a PROXY: surfnerd.com/surf-forecast/del-monte-beach "Workable swell: W - N", "northwest the best match"; surf-forecast.com/breaks/Del-Monte-Beach "the best swell direction is from the northwest". Window W to N (270-0, no pad); the straight-ray cast opens no window here (sw1-raycast run 80). Optimal NW (315), also set in spot_swell_windows.json.
